# docker_tasks (Data Source)

Lists swarm tasks (`GET /tasks`), like `docker service ps`, `docker node ps` and `docker stack ps`; the provider's host must be a swarm manager. Sorted by name (`<service>.<slot>`, or `<service>.<node ID>` for global services) then ID. `tasks` holds each Engine task object (`tasks[0].status.state`, `tasks[0].status.container_status.container_id`); only the container environment inside it is sensitive. Filter by `service_id`, `node_id`, `desired_state`, `name` and `labels`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Like `docker service ps web`.
data "docker_tasks" "web" {
  service_id    = "web"
  desired_state = "running"
}

output "web_tasks" {
  value = { for t in data.docker_tasks.web.tasks : t.id => t.status.state }
}

# Like `docker node ps worker1`.
data "docker_tasks" "on_worker1" {
  node_id = "worker1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `desired_state` (String) Only tasks with this desired state: `running`, `shutdown` or `accepted`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Only objects carrying every one of these labels (Engine `label` filter); an empty value matches any value.
- `name` (String) Only objects whose name matches (Engine `name` filter, a prefix/substring match).
- `node_id` (String) Only tasks on this node (ID or name; Engine `node` filter).
- `service_id` (String) Only tasks of this service (ID or name; Engine `service` filter).

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of tasks_json; changes whenever the object changes.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon the provider talked to (GET /version Version).
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version the provider negotiated with the daemon (GET /version ApiVersion, capped by the client's max).
- `ids` (List of String) IDs of the matching objects, in the order of `tasks`.
- `names` (List of String) Names of the matching objects, in the order of `tasks`.
- `tasks` (Attributes List) Every task returned by the list endpoint, each mirroring Task field by field (snake_case). Only ContainerSpec.Env and volume driver options are sensitive (field-level); the rest, including Args/Command, stays plain in plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))
- `tasks_json` (String, Sensitive) The Engine API GET /tasks response as JSON; entries sorted by name, then ID. Re-encoded, not byte-exact: the moby client keeps no raw body for this call, so this is the decoded response written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact). Only ContainerSpec.Env and volume driver options are sensitive (field-level); the rest, including Args/Command, stays plain in plans.
